name: Hermes Agent
description: Hermes Agent is a self-hosted AI agent by Nous Research. It runs a persistent gateway (connecting to Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, or via OpenAI-compatible API) alongside a web dashboard. Terminal commands are executed in isolated Docker containers for sandboxed code execution.
short_desc: Self-hosted AI agent with web dashboard by Nous Research.
author: nousresearch

form_fields.label: Gateway API Port
form_fields.hint: External port for the OpenAI-compatible API server. Maps to internal port 8642.

form_fields.label: API Server Key
form_fields.hint: Optional key to secure API access (min 8 chars). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

form_fields.label: API CORS Origins
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins for the API server.

form_fields.label: Container UID
form_fields.hint: User ID for the process inside the container. Match your host user's UID (run 'id -u') for correct file permissions on the data volume.

form_fields.label: Container GID
form_fields.hint: Group ID for the process inside the container. Match your host user's GID (run 'id -g') for correct file permissions on the data volume.
